correctness.rationale: For S=I+hA SPD and T=I-hB symmetric, M=S^-1 T is similar to S^-1/2 T S^-1/2 with -I<K<I because S±T positive. Hence spectral stability for all h>0. Norm(M)<=1 iff T^2<=S^2 by congruence, equivalent to 2(A+B)+h(A^2-B^2)>=0. In a basis beginning with u, the positive block 4C has Schur complement 2(2alpha+rho)(1+2t)-4lambda(1+t)^2 with t=h rho/4 and lambda=g^T C^-1 g=alpha-(u^T B^-1 u)^-1. The scalar quadratic F(t)=1+2t-kappa(1+t)^2 has a unique nonnegative cutoff exactly h*=4 sqrt(1-kappa)/[rho(1-sqrt(1-kappa))], infinite if lambda=0, strict/pseudonorm boundaries correct. Two-eigenvalue expansion lambda~(b2-b1)^2 theta^2/b2 yields theta^-2 horizon. Recomputed exact 2x2 witness det=-256 and independently tested random SPD n2,3,5; numerical tests do not prove all n.
